_notes: S01 plan and credit configuration, read by eo/plans.py and eo/usage_ledger.py.

credits_per_usd is Decision D5 (m2c_build_plan.md): 1 credit = a fixed USD amount. PLACEHOLDER: 1000 means 1 credit = $0.001, chosen only so every pool below is a whole number of credits. Changing it rescales how fast pools drain, so change it together with the credit_pool values and, if accounts already hold user_plans rows, with those rows too (they store their own credit_pool).

credit_pool per plan = the LLM subtotal of 'COGS at cap' in MiniMe_Financial_Strategy_Rulebook.md section 8.2 (USD per user per month if every LLM pool is used 100%) x credits_per_usd: Basic 1.69, Moderate 7.11, Ultimate 20.73. Non-LLM costs (search, images, TTS, sandbox) are not metered by this ledger, so they are excluded. Free = 0.30M tokens x $0.27/M = $0.081 (Rulebook section 7.4).

The Rulebook meters four per-class token pools and the Feature Guide quotes yet another token table; the build plan (O2/D5) specifies ONE cost-weighted credit pool. This file follows the build plan. Reconcile before launch.

unpriced_usd_per_million_tokens: a call whose provider/model has no price-table entry (cost_usd is NULL) is charged tokens x this rate instead of being metered as free. Deliberately above the priced entries in utils/llm_client.py. S02 (credit weighting) replaces this with per-model prices.

A call with no token counts and no price at all (some Cloudflare responses omit usage) is charged 0 credits: there is nothing measured to charge. The row is still written, with NULL tokens and NULL cost_usd, so it can be found.
